detail: Full summary: MCP server path builds the context with no offline flag, so a first-use Hugging Face download of Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 can happen from the server; no env or config surface exists to prevent it — R18's tested-local deployment needs TWINING_OFFLINE / embeddings.offline (add at merge).
